entries.title: Leviticus 2:1
segments: ¶And when any will offer a meat offering unto the LORD, his offering shall be [of] fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:

entries.title: Leviticus 2:2
segments: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, [to be] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD:

words.text: , [to be] an offering made by fire

entries.title: Leviticus 2:3
segments: And the remnant of the meat offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons': [it is] a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:4
segments: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, [it shall be] unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:5
segments: And if thy oblation [be] a meat offering [baken] in a pan, it shall be [of] fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil. {in a pan: or, on a flat plate, or, slice}

words.text: . {in a pan: or, on a flat plate, or, slice}

entries.title: Leviticus 2:6
segments: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it [is] a meat offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:7
segments: And if thy oblation [be] a meat offering [baken] in the fryingpan, it shall be made [of] fine flour with oil.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:8
segments: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the LORD: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.

words.text: of these things unto the LORD

entries.title: Leviticus 2:9
segments: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn [it] upon the altar: [it is] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.

words.text: : [it is] an offering made by fire

entries.title: Leviticus 2:10
segments: And that which is left of the meat offering [shall be] Aaron's and his sons': [it is] a thing most holy of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:11
segments: ¶No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the LORD, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the LORD made by fire.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:12
segments: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the LORD: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour. {be burnt: Heb. ascend}

words.text: : but they shall not be burnt

entries.title: Leviticus 2:13
segments: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

words.text: ; neither shalt thou suffer the salt

entries.title: Leviticus 2:14
segments: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the LORD, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, [even] corn beaten out of full ears.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:15
segments: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it [is] a meat offering.

entries.title: Leviticus 2:16
segments: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, [part] of the beaten corn thereof, and [part] of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: [it is] an offering made by fire unto the LORD.

words.text: of it, [part] of the beaten corn
thereof: [it is] an offering made by fire
